action_items: (low) Replace remaining text-glyph controls in PlayerModal audio branch with Lucide icons: '⌄' → ChevronDown (player-close), '⏮' → SkipBack (player-prev), '⏭' → SkipForward (player-next) to fully match the 'no emoji' cleanup contract.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/stories.py is 152 lines, clean and self-contained; correct RBAC via write_dep = require_role(*MEDIA_WRITE_ROLES); list_stories filters expired via gt('expires_at', now_iso()) and hides stories without media_path (not_.is_('media_path', 'null')) — good. Author names batched via single IN query. View tracking via story_views upsert with on_conflict='story_id,user_id' + ignore_duplicates — correct idempotence.
media.py attach_stream_urls uses create_signed_urls (batch) with 6h TTL — efficient, one round-trip for the whole list. Falls back gracefully if signature fails (logs warning). Good.

media.py faststart_in_place uses qtfaststart processor with local tempfiles and re-uploads with upsert=true; only runs for mp4/m4a/m4v/mov and returns silently if already optimized. Correct approach; wrapped in try/except in confirm_upload so upload confirmation never fails on faststart error.

PlayerModal.tsx correctly branches: audio uses Lucide Moon/Play/Pause/Heart icons; video uses VideoScreen. Audio src uses item.stream_url || mediaFileUrl(item.id, token!) — falls back gracefully if stream_url missing. Sommeil label + Moon icon composition is clean.
StoriesStrip.tsx correctly hides the entire strip when neither canPublish nor any story is present; uses LinearGradient ring for unread (gold→ruby) vs viewed (grey border) — nice UX.
stories.tsx viewer: markView mutation invalidates ['stories'] on success — the strip will refresh viewed=true. Long-press pauses image timer via onPressOut cleanup. Good.

story-new.tsx correctly gates entire screen for non-technique with early return + explanation text; on web platform correctly uses fetch(uri).blob() fallback when picker doesn't yield a File object. iOS/Android path uses FileSystem.uploadAsync BINARY_CONTENT — correct.
